actualBrowserObservations.publishPage: Generic Become a plugin publisher application form, not an application-specific review screen.
actualBrowserObservations.searchControl: Search plugins, automations, and agent templates
actualBrowserObservations.limit: Actual typed name query only; does not expose private review state or prove absence under every identifier.

boundedFeedbackSearch.scope: Existing publisher mailbox; seven-day query constrained to Cursor/Anthropic/Claude/Smithery/Arcade senders and beancount/bex-co terms.
boundedFeedbackSearch.limit: No claim about every sender, mailbox or private dashboard; unrelated messages not opened and nothing sent.

unblock: Cursor supplies actionable feedback or publishes the existing application; worker verifies the official public/native install path.
